scope: TEST and LIVE tenant-scoped projection candidate reads; no source-provider or customer data writes by the migration

source.change: Use an indexed NOT EXISTS anti-probe for the ordered unlinked-email scan in place of the equivalent LEFT JOIN/IS NULL form. Draft, exact revision, current review and Phone selection logic are retained.

diagnosis.oldReadOnlyPlan: The old form used a right hash join and sort over the tenant's retained email and interaction rows before LIMIT 200; its 200-ID aggregate took 3706 ms in one management read.
diagnosis.newReadOnlyPlan: The equivalent NOT EXISTS form used learn_email_projection_order_idx with an index-only anti-probe into interactions_tenant_id_source_table_source_id_key; its 200-ID aggregate took 434 ms in one management read. These are point samples, not a throughput guarantee.

reviewHoldAudit.handling: No inferred customer, job or staff identity is published for these holds. The worker's review_required terminal label records a durable hold and can coexist with committed unrelated records and a continuation.

limits: Two ordinary LIVE batches and one service API sample do not establish full-day unattended reliability.
At 07:45:54 UTC, 6314 eligible retained emails still lacked interactions; fresh source capture increased this gap during the observation.
No business acceptance or full application/Auth restore is claimed.
